payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: one rule for your landings, starting with 0078. Apply your patch only into a primary that holds no one else's uncommitted hunks. Check git status first, and if anything is there that is not yours, stop and tell me. Right now utilz-cc's 0077 and 0079 candidate is uncommitted in the primary, including CHANGELOG.md; I've asked cc to move it into a worktree after its run's END. Your worktrees are the right pattern; keep them.
